summary: Well-designed, preregistered controlled-fault paired experiment evaluating verifier-guided vs blind LLM repair on vendor-CLI synthetic tasks. Execution and analysis follow the preregistration; artifacts and provenance are archived. Primary paired test (n=39) shows a guarded − baseline absolute improvement ≈20.5 percentage points (n10=9, n01=1), exact two-sided McNemar p=0.02148, 95% paired-bootstrap CI ≈ [0.0769,0.359].
critical_issues: References and in-text citation semantics are not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata in the manuscript; the paper instead defers to artifact-bundle identifiers. The submission must include a standard IEEE-style References section (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/URL where applicable) and numeric in-text citation markers that map to those entries.

The Related Work paragraph contains claims tied to numbered markers but the manuscript does not supply conventional bibliographic entries to verify that each cited record actually supports the nearby claim. This prevents independent readers/reviewers from checking citation semantics in the paper body.
required_revisions: Insert a conventional IEEE-formatted References section into the manuscript (within the five-page limit) providing full bibliographic metadata for every cited work referenced in-text; replace or augment artifact-bundle identifiers so each in-text numeric marker maps to a complete IEEE entry.

Ensure each in-text citation marker references a corresponding IEEE bibliography entry and verify that every citation in prose is supported by the cited record; if any claim exceeds what the cited source supports, weaken or rephrase the claim accordingly.

Remove or reword the sentence that defers citation verification to the artifact bundle (e.g., delete 'Cited works are listed by verified identifier in the artifact bundle; in-text numbered markers refer to that bundle.'); the manuscript must be self-contained with standard in-text citations and References.
optional_revisions: Report a conventional exact confidence interval for the paired difference (or an exact conditional CI for the discordant-based effect) alongside the paired-bootstrap CI to aid readers preferring nonresampling intervals.

Add a short table in Results (or Appendix within the five pages) summarizing per-condition model-call counts and mean latency/cost per successful repair to make the recorded verifier 'tax' instrumentation visible in the paper text (artifacts already archived).
Clarify in Methods the exact computation used for the reported McNemar exact two-sided p-value (optional explicit formula or reference) for transparency.
